interface.name: treeland_pickcolor_manager_v1
interface.description:
This global is a factory interface for creating color picker objects. Clients can use it to initiate color picking operations.
This interface provides the capability to create color picker objects that can sample colors from the screen with high precision, including color space information.

enum.name: error
enum.description: These errors can be emitted in response to requests.

request.name: get_pickcolor
request.description:
Create a new color picker object. The compositor may start capturing input or displaying relevant UI when the picker is activated.
The picker will be created in an inactive state and must be explicitly activated using the activate request.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the color picker manager. All associated picker objects remain valid but no new pickers can be created.

interface.name: treeland_pickcolor_v1
interface.description:
A color picker object allows the client to receive color values selected from the screen. When active, the compositor may listen for user input, such as mouse clicks, and respond by sending the corresponding color.
The picker operates in different states and can provide detailed color information including color space data and pixel coordinates.

enum.name: error
enum.description: These errors can be emitted in response to requests.

entry.name: invalid_state
entry.summary: operation not valid in current state

enum.name: state
enum.description: Describes the current state of the color picker.

entry.name: active
entry.summary: picker is active and waiting for input

enum.name: colorspace
enum.description: Supported color spaces for color data.

event.name: state_changed
event.description: Sent when the picker state changes. Clients should update their UI or behavior accordingly.

event.name: color
event.description:
Sent when the user picks a color. Typically triggered when the user clicks on a point on the screen while the picker is active.
Each channel is represented as a 32-bit unsigned integer in the range 0 to 4294967295 (inclusive), allowing for high-precision color data. The values are unpremultiplied.
The coordinates indicate the exact pixel location where the color was sampled, in surface-local coordinates of the output.

arg.name: colorspace
arg.summary: color space of the sampled color

event.name: error
event.description: Sent when an error occurs during color picking operation. The picker may become inactive as a result.

request.name: activate
request.description: Activate the color picker to start capturing user input. The compositor should show appropriate UI and start monitoring for user interactions.

request.name: pick_at
request.description:
Request to pick a color at specific coordinates without waiting for user input. The coordinates are in global compositor space.
This is useful for programmatic color sampling.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the color picker. The compositor may stop listening for input or hide related UI as a result.

request.name: pause
request.description:
Temporarily pause the color picking operation. The compositor may suspend input monitoring or hide UI, but should preserve the picker state.
The picker state will change to paused.

request.name: resume
request.description:
Resume a previously paused picker operation. The compositor should resume input handling and restore any relevant UI.
The picker state will change back to active.
